items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: he wanted me to play with him... We rehearsed up there in this place, in the club he had.

ctx.x: Where did you run into him?
He was here. I went up where he was staying. A lady had a club, and he was supposed to have been her old man, I think. And she got tired, and he left there. He was a pain in the ass, Jelly Roll was.
He said one time he wanted to get you to join one of his bands.
